items.headline: ALB vs. SQM: Which Lithium Stock Should You Bet on Now?
items.snippet: Albemarle is well-placed to gain from long-term growth in the battery-grade lithium market. ALB expects lithium demand to witness a CAGR of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030, with growth already trending near the higher end of the range this year.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $225 from $245 at Truist
items.snippet: Truist analyst Peter Osterland lowered the firm's price target on Albemarle to $225 from $245 and keeps a Buy rating on the shares, citing resilient lithium demand and constrained supply dynamics.
